1871 epaiteo {ep-ahee-teh'-o}

源自 1909 與 154; 動詞

欽定本 - to beg 1; 1

1) 要求更多, 祈求更多
2) 乞求, 乞求施捨 (#路 16:3|)
record.edic_text:
1871 epaiteo {ep-ahee-teh'-o}

from 1909 and 154;; v

AV - to beg 1; 1

1) to ask besides, ask for more
2) to ask again and again, importunately
3) to beg, to ask alms
